name: gp154_phase_flow_law
notes: Quantitative-discovery rubric with custom nd_features hard gate. The target is smoothed local alpha, not raw loss and not the old scalar curve exponent.
__do_not_run_live_reason: Dormant GP-154 fork with no matching project directory in the current repo; recover the project surface before running.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: Evidence is an nd_features trajectory packet with a custom whole-run gate harness, not a single fit expression over n.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Uniqueness is judged by explicit progress-only/loglog-clock rivals and whole-run transfer, not keyword form heuristics.
farther_tail_region_disable_reason: Custom gate_harness.py defines farther-tail as a whole-run blinded split over phase-flow rows. There is no single coordinate-range extrapolation region for the generic global_extrapolation_gap gate; extrapolation pressure is enforced by evidence_holdout.txt and gate_harness.py.
enable_fit_primitive_features_reason: Disabled after iter1 SciPy fit on 65,658 visible local-alpha rows remained CPU-bound for >16 minutes. This substrate is currently mechanism/search-oriented; deterministic fit audits are run offline on stable-core packets.
fit_primitive_features_k_max_reason: The live question is whether a compact clock/config function explains local-alpha flow. K<=8 permits log/loglog clock terms plus small config modulation while blocking lookup tables.
analogy_domain_hint: renormalization group flows, glassy aging clocks, and functional data collapse
enable_cold_llm_erdos_seed_reason: The substrate needs de-anchoring from scalar exponent language toward functional collapse and clock transforms.
cold_llm_seed_forbidden_domain: machine learning, deep learning, neural-network scaling, AI

evidence_contract.docstring: gp154_phase_flow_law is cage_meta.class=nd_features. Each row is a feature dict; target is smoothed local alpha from normalized training trajectories.

persona: You are an adversarial reviewer for neural scaling-law discovery. The old scalar exponent law has been retired; this project tests whether local exponent flow collapses under metadata clock transforms. Penalize any thesis that memorizes blinded run ids, source identity, or phase labels as a lookup table. Reward compact functional-collapse laws that beat progress-only rivals on whole-run holdout and explain why log/loglog clocks are or are not mechanistic.

dimensions.name: Functional Collapse
dimensions.description: Find a compact executable law for alpha_local as a function of metadata clock and configuration. Full credit requires more than rephrasing scalar alpha.

dimensions.name: Whole Run Transfer
dimensions.description: Pass holdout and farther-tail gates built from whole blinded runs, not random local rows.

dimensions.name: Rival Rejection
dimensions.description: Explicitly beat or explain the progress-only rival and compare against the seeded log/loglog clock law.

dimensions.name: Leakage Discipline
dimensions.description: Do not use run ids, source provenance, model names, or post-hoc phase labels as mechanisms.

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: State what clock transform would make the flow universal and how the claim could fail on OLMo2 1B or another fresh packet.

criteria.Functional Collapse: Scores whether the candidate gives a compact executable alpha_local=f(clock, config) law rather than a scalar-alpha or lookup-table story.
criteria.Whole Run Transfer: Scores whether the deterministic whole-run holdout and farther-tail gates pass with meaningful error margins.
criteria.Rival Rejection: Scores comparison against progress-only and log/loglog seeded rivals.
criteria.Leakage Discipline: Scores avoidance of provenance leakage, run-id lookup, and circular phase definitions.
criteria.Generative Yield: Scores whether the thesis yields a falsifiable clock-transform or functional-collapse mechanism for fresh validation.
